描述_EN: fang's character was the clever one of the group, so before he is reversed into a werebear, he wears a school cap on his head. there were four werebears; gums (this one), fang, grizzler and howler, with a back-story that told how as ordinary teddy bears they were turned into the werebears by the light of the full moon. the werebears were designed to appeal to boys interests in the same way that the care bears appealed to girls. manufacture of the werebears toys halted in the early 1990s, but interest still prevails, with an attempt at relaunching the characters in 2009. each bear was sold with his own story tape, narrated by oliver postgate. the name is an allusion to the very popular toy series care bears, by american greetings, which were ubiquitous in the 1980s. the toy was designed so that its head and paws were reversible, revealing a scary face and claws. the toy was part of the werebears range, created by artist george nicholas. this is a stuffed toy teddy bear which was owned by james davis, who received the toy as a christmas present in 1990 when he was five years old.
描述_ZN: fang的角色是这群人中最聪明的一个，所以在他变成狼人之前，他的头上戴着一顶学生帽。 there were four werebears; gums (this one), fang, grizzler and howler, with a back-story that told how as ordinary teddy bears they were turned into the werebears by the light of the full moon. 狼人的设计是为了吸引男孩的兴趣，就像护理熊吸引女孩一样。 狼人玩具的生产在20世纪90年代初停止了，但人们的兴趣仍然存在，2009年曾试图重新推出这些人物。 每只熊都有自己的故事带出售，由奥利弗-波盖特讲述。 这个名字是对非常流行的玩具系列care bears的影射，由American greetings制作，在80年代无处不在。 这个玩具被设计成它的头和爪子可以翻转，露出可怕的脸和爪子。 这个玩具是Werebears系列的一部分，由艺术家George Nicholas创作。 这是一个填充玩具泰迪熊，由詹姆斯-戴维斯拥有，他在1990年5岁时收到了这个玩具作为圣诞礼物。
